On this small intercropped plot, I will manage it in the simple way I can afford. I do not have enough money for chemical fertilizer or improved seed, and here we mostly depend on the rains, not irrigation. I can put some manure or compost if I get it, and we will use our own family work, with only a little hired help if needed for heavy work.
